claim.claim-text: 2. The drainage system of claim 1, wherein the retaining ring (246) has a constant inner diameter.
3. The drainage system of claim 1, further comprising a spiked tube positioned at least partially within the cap (216) and configured to pierce the frangible seal.

4. The drainage system of claim 3, wherein a vacuum is transferred from the interior of the container (212) to a space defined by the cap (216), and the interior of the container is in patent fluid communication with the space defined by the cap when the frangible seal is pierced.
5. The drainage system of claim 1, wherein the cap (216) comprises a tapered widened body.

6. The drainage system of claim 1, wherein the retaining ring (246) includes a weakened area (252) with a lower critical strength than an adjacent area (250) such that the retaining ring breaks at the weakened area in response to an input force from a user.
7. The drainage system of claim 1, wherein the interior of the container (212) holds a vacuum.

8. The drainage system of claim 1, wherein a stop (260) extends outwardly from the mouth (214) along a shoulder of container and the retaining ring (246) rests on the stop when the retaining ring is radially aligned with the O-ring (240) and coaxial with the O-ring.
9. A drainage system (210), the drainage system comprising:
10. The drainage system (210) of claim 9, the drainage system further comprising:

a frangible seal covering the opening and maintaining a vacuum within the container (212) while the frangible seal is intact; and a tube located at least partially within the cap, the tube having a spike, wherein the spike is configured to pierce the frangible seal.
11. The drainage system of claim 9, wherein the O-ring (240) is configured to provide a friction force for securing the cap (216) to the mouth.
12. The drainage system of claim 9, wherein the cap (216) further comprises a tapered portion.
13. The drainage system of claim 9, wherein the cap (216) is opaque.
14. The drainage system of claim 9, wherein an interior of the container (212) contains a vacuum.
15. The drainage system of claim 9, wherein the drainage line provides fluid communication with a collection device.

16. The drainage system of claim 9, wherein a stop (260) extends outwardly along a shoulder of container (212) and the retaining ring (246) rests on the stop when the retaining ring is radially aligned with the O-ring (240) and coaxial with the O-ring.
